title: Flat local extension with a given residue field extension
statement: Let $R$ be a local ring (a commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal) with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $\kappa=R/\mathfrak m$, and let $K$ be a field together with a ring homomorphism $\kappa\to K$ (a field extension $K/\kappa$). Then there exist a local ring $R'$ with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m'$ and residue field $\kappa'=R'/\mathfrak m'$, a ring homomorphism $\varphi:R\to R'$ which is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and local ($\varphi(\mathfrak m)\subseteq\mathfrak m'$) and satisfies $\mathfrak m'=\mathfrak mR'$ (the ideal of $R'$ generated by $\varphi(\mathfrak m)$), and an isomorphism of fields $\kappa'\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ compatible with the maps from $\kappa$ (here $\kappa\to\kappa'$ is the map induced by $\varphi$).

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 03C3 (lemma-flat-local-given-residue-field, line 44573); used in the proof of Lemma Tag 0328 (lemma-cohen-rings-exist, line 44878)

proof.text: Apply exists_residue_field_tower_system to obtain local flat R-algebras A_i, coherent algebra transition maps, and compatible maps ψ_i to K with stage kernels m_i and stage images covering K. The index type is ULift K in Type(max u v), so the explicit algebra direct limit has exactly the universe required by the statement.

Let S be DirectLimit A f, φ its algebra map, and q the compatible lift of ψ to K. The stage compatibility gives q∘φ=ι∘residue_R. Since ι is a field homomorphism it is injective, so ker(ι∘residue_R)=m_R. Apply flat_local_tower_directLimit: S is local, φ is local and flat, m_R S=m_S and ker q=m_S.

Coverage supplies, for each x∈K, a stage element mapping to x. Its coprojection to S proves q surjective. Since ker q=m_S, q reflects units, so ResidueField.lift q is defined. It is injective as a field homomorphism and surjective by lifting representatives through residue_S. Thus RingEquiv.ofBijective produces e:κ(S)≃K.

To prove compatibility of e with κ(R)→κ(S), represent any residue class of R by r∈R. ResidueField.map sends it to residue_S(φ(r)), and e sends this to q(φ(r))=ι(residue_R(r)). Ring-hom extensionality proves the required equality without changing any binder of the original statement.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks Algebra 03C3 (lemma-flat-local-given-residue-field, tag verified in tags/tags) and its proof, and the citer lem-weil-pbc-cohen-rings-exist step 2 (uses: R local, flat local Z_p -> R, m_R = pR, R/m_R = k; the statement gives exactly this, kept unchanged). Not a Mathlib leaf (LeanSearch, LeanFinder, grep, recorded). Nine steps following the four paragraphs of the proof, phrased with 'R-towers' (local A with maximal ideal mA, flat R -> A, phi: A -> K with kernel mA): Claim M (monogenic step; transcendental case via R[x] localized at mR[x], algebraic case via R[T]/(monic lift of the minimal polynomial), with locality, kernel and image checked), Claim C (directed colimit of towers is a tower: locality from elementwise description, flatness by showing the ring colimit is the module colimit), the well-ordering and subfields K(x), the transfinite recursion with an explicit rule G_x and induction for coherence, and the final colimit over all of K. Existing nodes cited: flat-ring-map, free-module, projective-module-flat, localization-flat, flat-ring-map-comp, monic-quotient-free, finite-algebra-local-radical, simple-algebraic-extension-power-basis, separable-algebraic-extension (minimal polynomial), commutative-algebras-colimits-exist, filtered-colimit-algebras-elementwise, filtered-colimit-rings-zero, filtered-colimit-flat-modules, well-ordering-theorem, and definitions. One new Mathlib leaf: lem-weil-pbc-transfinite-recursion (WellFoundedLT.fix / fix_eq). Gaps of the source filled: the source's recursion takes at the least element a colimit over the empty set (which would be Z, not R); it ends at 'R(x)' for each x without the final colimit over all x (needed when K has no largest element); and it does not check that its two monogenic rings are local with residue field k(alpha).

lean.statement: theorem exists_flat_local_extension_given_residue_field (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (K : Type v) [Field K] (ι : ResidueField R →+* K) : ∃ (S : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing S) (_ : IsLocalRing S) (φ : R →+* S) (_ : IsLocalHom φ), φ.Flat ∧ (maximalIdeal R).map φ = maximalIdeal S ∧ ∃ e : ResidueField S ≃+* K, e.toRingHom.comp (ResidueField.map φ) = ι
